'''Nichole M. Danzl''' is an American astronomer and biologist who has discovered several [[trans-Neptunian object]]s while working with the [[Spacewatch]] survey.<ref name="MPC-Asteroid" />

== Career ==
Danzl studied biology at the [[University of Arizona]]. She is a research scientist, at the [[Columbia University Irving Medical Center|Columbia University Medical Center.]]<ref name="ssrn" /> Between 1995 and 1998, she discovered a total of six [[minor planet]]s, as part of her work on the [[Spacewatch]] program.<ref name="MPC-Discoverers" />

== Honors and awards ==
Asteroid [[10720 Danzl]], discovered by astronomers with the Spacewatch survey at [[Kitt Peak Observatory]] in 1986, was named after her.<ref name="MPC-Circulars-Archive" /> The official {{MoMP|10720|naming citation}} was published by the [[Minor Planet Center]] on 9 May 2001 ({{small|[[Minor Planet Circulars|M.P.C.]] 42671}}).<ref name="MPC-Asteroid" />
